package lib

// Filters is a named slice type - the cross-package GET_METHOD
// receiver case the compile-time getMethodReceiverTypeNames table
// exists to support. The runtime reflect.Type for a slice has no
// fields, so the `_pikoID_<Name>` sentinel can't carry the name;
// the compiler-recorded "Filters" entry on the GET_METHOD's PC is
// what handleGetMethod consults to look up "Filters.Match" in
// globalStore.externalMethods.
type Filters []func(int) bool

func NewFilters() Filters {
	return Filters{}
}

func (f Filters) Add(predicate func(int) bool) Filters {
	return append(f, predicate)
}

func (f Filters) Match(candidate int) bool {
	for _, predicate := range f {
		if !predicate(candidate) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func GreaterThan(threshold int) func(int) bool {
	return func(value int) bool { return value > threshold }
}

func LessThan(threshold int) func(int) bool {
	return func(value int) bool { return value < threshold }
}

func NotEqual(other int) func(int) bool {
	return func(value int) bool { return value != other }
}
